title: Generative Representation Learning for Scalable Latent Tokenization
title_zh: 用于可扩展潜在标记化的生成式表示学习

paragraphs.en: We introduce an approach for self-supervised representation learning designed to be used as a tokenizer for generative modeling. Our objective supervises a representation loss by factorizing the pointwise mutual information of the data, which we estimate by taking information differences between conditional predictions from a learned generative model. We justify our algorithm theoretically and empirically, demonstrating that our generative approach to representation learning avoids dimensional collapse and feature suppression in cases where commonly used methods like DINO and LeJEPA fail. Moreover, we show our representation learning technique is scalable; expending more compute leads to predictably better latent tokenization. For the first time, we perform a careful analysis of the combined flop efficiency of tokenizer and generative model and demonstrate that our approach is a compute-optimal improvement over direct diffusion for pixel-space generation, obtaining an FID-50K of 2.18 with JiT-L. Applied to ImageNet and the text-to-image dataset GPIC, we show tokenizer encoder scaling laws for diffusability, where extrapolating our approach achieves representations in 𝟕 × \mathbf{7\times} fewer FLOPs than DINOv2 on ImageNet and 𝟖 × \mathbf{8\times} fewer FLOPs than WebSSL on GPIC. Code at https://github.com/AlanBaade/repr

paragraphs.en: Representation learning decides what information matters. Traditionally, that decision has been guided by downstream tasks: augmentation invariance, for example, encourages representations that preserve semantic content while discarding other latent variables. Yet representations designed this way have become a foundation for generative modeling, serving as latent tokenizers for diffusion models. Methods such as RAE ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , for example, inherit encoders like DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) , whose objectives were not designed to make generation easier. Moreover, these encoders can require orders of magnitude more data and compute to train than the generative models built on top of them. This leaves two basic questions unresolved: what makes a representation good for generation, and is learning one actually more compute-efficient than modeling pixels directly?
paragraphs.zh: 表示学习决定了哪些信息是重要的。 传统上，这一决策由下游任务引导：例如，增强不变性会促使模型生成能够保留语义内容同时舍弃其他潜在变量的表示。 然而，以这种方式设计的表示已成为生成式建模的基础，用作扩散模型的潜在分词器。 例如，RAE（Zheng 等人，2026）等方法继承了类似 DINOv2（Oquab 等人，2024）的编码器，而这些编码器的目标并非为了简化生成过程而设计。 此外，训练这些编码器可能需要比构建在其之上的生成模型多几个数量级的数据和计算资源。 这留下了两个基本问题尚未解决：什么样的表示才适合生成任务，以及学习这样的表示是否真的比直接建模像素更高效？

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we seek to discover whether there is a representation learning algorithm that demonstrates tokenizer encoder scaling laws: As more compute and data is given to train the tokenizer, generative models trained on these representations converge faster, and the compute optimal balance between training a tokenizer and generative model places nonzero weight on tokenization. Although prior work has shown scaling laws for tokenization ( Yao et al., 2025a ; Hansen-Estruch et al., 2026 ) , these works couple tokenizer decoders, which are a part of the generative process that has been widely shown to improve with scale ( Kaplan et al., 2020 ) , with tokenizer encoders that instead have been shown to worsen with scale ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ; Hansen-Estruch et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2025b ) , a phenomenon we discuss in depth.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们试图探索是否存在一种表示学习算法能够展现出分词器编码器的扩展定律：随着用于训练分词器的计算资源和数据量增加，基于这些表示训练的生成模型会更快收敛，而在分词器和生成模型训练之间达到计算资源最优平衡时，分词过程会被赋予非零权重。 尽管先前的研究已经揭示了分词过程的扩展定律（Yao et al., 2025a；Hansen-Estruch et al., 2026），但这些研究将分词器解码器——一个已被广泛证明会随着规模扩大而改进的生成过程组成部分（Kaplan et al., 2020）——与分词器编码器（Siméoni et al., 2025；Hansen-Estruch et al., 2026；Yao et al., 2025b）耦合在了一起，而后者则被证明会随着规模扩大而表现变差，这一现象我们将在下文深入讨论。

paragraphs.en: Toward the goal of discovering scalable encoders, we identify three primary reasons for the failures of current recipes. 1) Feature suppression: Standard representation learning techniques such as Contrastive Learning ( Hadsell et al., 2006 ; van den Oord et al., 2018a ) and LeJEPA ( Balestriero and LeCun, 2025 ) can have their objectives saturated by a small number of bits, behavior commonly referred to as feature suppression ( Geirhos et al., 2020 ; Chen et al., 2021a ) . Although suppressed objectives may be ideal for tasks like ImageNet probing, where only a few semantic bits need highlighting, in generative modeling all latent variables in the data are sampled. 2) Causal Theoretical Grounding: Representation learning algorithms like contrastive learning optimize a CLS token, but the tokenizer used by methods like RAE is instead “emergent” internal patch features that have demonstrated instability under scaling ( Darcet et al., 2024 ) . 3) Architectural scalability: Classic tokenizers such as VAEs ( Kingma and Welling, 2022 ) and VQ-VAE ( van den Oord et al., 2018b ) bottleneck gradient descent through techniques like the reparameterization trick or straight-through gradient estimation and fail to learn semantics ( Yao et al., 2025b ) , resulting in the transition toward tokenizers based on representation learning such as DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 为了探索可扩展的编码器这一目标，我们识别出当前方法失败的三个主要原因。1) 特征抑制：标准的表示学习技术，如对比学习（Hadsell 等，2006；van den Oord 等，2018a）和 LeJEPA（Balestriero 和 LeCun，2025），其目标可能因少量比特而饱和，这种现象通常被称为特征抑制（Geirhos 等，2020；Chen 等，2021a）。 尽管被抑制的目标对于 ImageNet 探测等任务可能是理想的（因为这类任务只需突出少数语义比特），但在生成建模中，数据中的所有潜在变量都会被采样。2) 因果理论基础：对比学习等表示学习算法会优化一个 CLS 标记，但 RAE 等方法使用的标记器则是“涌现”的内部块特征，这些特征在扩展性方面表现出不稳定性（Darcet 等，2024）。3) 架构可扩展性：经典的标记器，如 VAE（Kingma 和 Welling，2022）和 VQ-VAE（van den Oord 等，2018b），通过重参数化技巧或直通梯度估计等方法限制了梯度下降，导致无法学习语义（Yao 等，2025b），因此转向了基于表示学习的标记器，例如 DINOv2（Oquab 等，2024）。

paragraphs.en: To address these issues preventing scalable representations, we propose an approach to move representation learning away from discriminative tasks, such as contrastive learning, and toward generative approaches instead. Specifically, we observe that Word Embeddings and Contrastive Learning implicitly factorize a pointwise mutual information (PMI) matrix of the data distribution ( Levy and Goldberg, 2014 ; van den Oord et al., 2018a ; Chen et al., 2023 ) . We propose to use a generative model to directly estimate a weighted PMI that our representation learner factorizes explicitly. By factorizing the PMI of the data, we directly inherit the long-studied theoretical properties of Contrastive Learning in our latent space. By using a generative objective instead of a discriminative objective, our approach both uses no negative samples and is robust to feature suppression, enabling our approach to directly supervise tokenizer patch feature representations rather than relying on intermediate features in a network ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) or excessively destroying information when directly using contrastive representations ( Ramesh, 2022 ) . Our PMI estimation inherits scalability from existing generative models, we use continuous gradient descent and standard Transformer architectures, and our representation supervision loss is directly interpretable as Nats Squared.

paragraphs.en: We empirically demonstrate our approach for the task of image generation on both ImageNet ( Deng et al., 2009 ) and GPIC ( Chandrasegaran et al., 2026 ) , a text-to-image dataset. We isolate our gains solely to the diffusability of the encoder by training generative models with Latent Forcing ( Baade et al., 2026 ) , demonstrating scaling directly on pixel generation while using no decoder, perceptual losses, adversarial losses, or external models. We further show that our approach is generalizable to different settings, such as unconditional generation, guided and unguided generation, and GAN+LPIPS decoding ( Goodfellow et al., 2021 ; Zhang et al., 2018 ) . Our resulting approach provides a FLOP-wise performance improvement over JiT, obtaining an FID-50K of 2.18 2.18 with JiT-L.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 ImageNet（Deng 等人，2009）和 GPIC（Chandrasegaran 等人，2026）这两个文本到图像数据集上，通过实证验证了我们的图像生成方法。 我们通过使用潜在强制法（Baade 等人，2026）训练生成模型，将性能提升完全归因于编码器的扩散能力，从而在不使用解码器、感知损失、对抗性损失或外部模型的情况下，直接展示了像素生成能力的可扩展性。 我们进一步证明，我们的方法可以推广到不同的设置中，例如无条件生成、引导生成和非引导生成，以及 GAN+LPIPS 解码（Goodfellow 等人，2021；Zhang 等人，2018）。 我们最终的方法在 FLOP 层面比 JiT 实现了性能提升，使用 JiT-L 时获得了 2.18 的 FID-50K 值。

paragraphs.en: In summary, we make the following contributions:

paragraphs.en: We introduce Relative Prediction Representations (RePR), a theoretically grounded representation learning algorithm for discovering latent variables within a signal that correlate between different masked views of the data.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了相对预测表示（Relative Prediction Representations，简称 RePR），这是一种具有理论基础的表示学习算法，旨在发现信号中那些在不同掩码数据视图之间存在相关性的潜在变量。

paragraphs.en: We provide a practical implementation on real high-dimensional image data.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在真实的高维图像数据上提供了实用的实现。

paragraphs.en: A careful analysis of tokenizer encoder scaling laws and the combined FLOP efficiency of representation learning and generative modeling, improving JiT-L FID-50K on ImageNet to 2.18 2.18 with equal FLOPs and extrapolating to equivalent tokenizer quality 7 × 7\times faster than DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) on ImageNet and 8 × 8\times WebSSL ( Fan et al., 2025 ) on GPIC.

paragraphs.en: Representation Learning. Contrastive Learners ( Chen et al., 2020 ; He et al., 2020 ) are a staple of representation learning that supervise a loss objective by encouraging high similarity between augmented views of the same scene and low similarity across different scenes. Empirically improving on contrastive-style objectives has seen great success in the widely-used DINO v1,v2,v3 series of models ( Caron et al., 2021 ; Oquab et al., 2024 ; Siméoni et al., 2025 ) . A longstanding flaw of contrastive objectives is that they struggle with strongly conditioned views, where hard negative examples ( Robinson et al., 2021 ) that prevent trivializing the objective are difficult to find. As a result, contrastive learning objectives often exhibit feature suppression ( Chen et al., 2021a ) , where contrastive representations only capture a subset of relevant variables in a scene, for example probing well to object class but losing scene structure. To combat issues of hard negatives and feature suppression, substantial effort has been devoted to designing hand-crafted augmentations intended to highlight signal for desired variables ( Chen et al., 2020 ) . Representation learning has also seen success through predictive objectives, such as predicting masked-out pixels in an image as done in Context Encoders and MAE ( Pathak et al., 2016 ; He et al., 2022 ) , or by replacing the pixel prediction target with a neural network latent such as BYOL, Data2Vec, JEPA, and MAGE ( Grill et al., 2020 ; Baevski et al., 2022 ; Assran et al., 2023 ; Bardes et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2022 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 表示学习。 对比学习器（Chen 等，2020；He 等，2020）是表示学习中的核心方法，它们通过鼓励同一场景的增强视图之间具有高相似性，以及不同场景之间的低相似性来监督损失目标。 经验上，改进对比风格的目标在广泛使用的 DINO v1、v2、v3 系列模型中取得了巨大成功（Caron 等，2021；Oquab 等，2024；Siméoni 等，2025）。 对比目标长期存在的一个缺陷是，它们难以处理强条件化的视图，其中很难找到能够防止目标被简化的困难负样本（Robinson 等，2021）。 因此，对比学习目标常常表现出特征抑制现象（Chen 等，2021a），即对比表示仅能捕捉场景中的部分相关变量，例如虽然能很好地识别物体类别，却丢失了场景结构。 为了解决困难负样本和特征抑制问题，研究人员投入了大量精力设计人工构造的增强方法，旨在突出目标变量的信号（Chen 等，2020）。 表示学习也通过预测目标取得了成功，例如在 Context Encoders 和 MAE 中预测图像中被掩码的像素（Pathak 等，2016；He 等，2022），或者将像素预测目标替换为神经网络的潜在变量，如 BYOL、Data2Vec、JEPA 和 MAGE（Grill 等，2020；Baevski 等，2022；Assran 等，2023；Bardes 等，2024；Li 等，2022）。

paragraphs.en: Pointwise Mutual Information and Representations The Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) of the data is closely tied to many representation learning algorithms. The connection between factorizing the PMI and representation learning was first established by Levy and Goldberg (2014) for Word2Vec ( Mikolov et al., 2013 ) and afterward extended to contrastive learning ( van den Oord et al., 2018a ; Chen et al., 2023 ) . The Platonic Representation Hypothesis ( Huh et al., 2024 ) proposes that large-scale neural networks emergently converge to similarly structured representations and suggests PMI factorization as a candidate for such a space. However, recent work ( Koepke et al., 2026 ) has shown that at large scales, neural representations fail to match such structure. In this work, we directly supervise representations to match the PMI, rather than assuming emergence at scale.
paragraphs.zh: 点互信息与表示 数据的点互信息（PMI）与许多表示学习算法密切相关。 Levy 和 Goldberg（2014）首次建立了 PMI 分解与表示学习之间的联系，当时针对的是 Word2Vec（Mikolov 等，2013），随后这一联系被扩展到了对比学习（van den Oord 等，2018a；Chen 等，2023）。 柏拉图表示假设（Huh 等，2024）提出，大规模神经网络会自发地收敛到具有相似结构的表示，并认为 PMI 分解可能是此类空间的一种候选方法。 然而，近期的研究（Koepke 等，2026）表明，在大规模情况下，神经表示未能匹配这种结构。 在本项工作中，我们直接对表示进行监督以匹配 PMI，而不是假设其会在大规模时自发形成。

paragraphs.en: Pixel and Latent Space Generative Modeling. The current state-of-the-art for image generative modeling uses diffusion transformers ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) , of which there are two main varieties: direct pixel diffusion and latent diffusion. A representative approach for pixel-space diffusion is JiT ( Li and He, 2026 ) , which demonstrated that pixel-space diffusion can be a practical and scalable method using transformer architectures. Meanwhile, latent diffusion ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2024a ) instead modifies generation into two stages, first creating a latent tokenizer, and second training a generative model on the tokenizer. Modern latent diffusion approaches like RAE ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) and REPA ( Yu et al., 2025 ) demonstrated strong results, attaining state-of-the-art FID values on ImageNet. However, RAE and REPA do not control for representation learner pretraining, where the chosen latent space, DINOv2-b ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) is distilled from a 1.1 billion parameter model trained on over 100 times more data than ImageNet. As a result, the FLOP-efficiency of representation encoding is not currently understood.
paragraphs.zh: 像素与潜在空间生成建模。 当前图像生成建模的顶尖技术采用扩散变换模型（Peebles 和 Xie，2023），其主要分为两种类型：直接像素扩散和潜在扩散。 像素空间扩散的代表性方法之一是 JiT（Li 和 He，2026），该方法证明了使用变换架构的像素空间扩散可以成为一种实用且可扩展的方法。 与此同时，潜在扩散（Rombach 等，2022；Li 等，2024a）则将生成过程分为两个阶段：首先创建一个潜在分词器，其次在该分词器上训练一个生成模型。 RAE（Zheng 等，2026）和 REPA（Yu 等，2025）等现代潜在扩散方法取得了优异成果，在 ImageNet 上达到了顶尖的 FID 值。 然而，RAE 和 REPA 并未对表示学习器的预训练进行控制，其中所选用的潜在空间 DINOv2-b（Oquab 等，2024）是从一个包含 11 亿个参数的模型中蒸馏而来的，而该模型训练数据量是 ImageNet 的 100 多倍。 因此，目前尚不清楚表示编码的 FLOP 效率。

paragraphs.en: Here, we describe how we instantiate RePR for learning representations from images. RePR consists of two learned networks: a “Prediction Model” that predicts masked inputs given partial observations (to estimate the PMI), and a “Representation Model” that outputs vectors given a partial input (into which we distill the PMI). In the following sections, we describe the Prediction Model (Sec. 5.1 ), the Representation Model for patch features (Sec. 5.2 ), how we mask views for PMI calculation (Sec. 5.3 ), and estimating the PMI with respect to latents for improved performance (Sec. 5.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在此，我们描述了如何为从图像中学习表示而实例化 RePR。 RePR 由两个学习得到的网络组成：一个“预测模型”，在给定部分观测结果时预测被掩码的输入（以估计 PMI）；以及一个“表示模型”，在给定部分输入时输出向量（我们将 PMI 蒸馏到其中）。 在接下来的各节中，我们将描述预测模型（第 5.1 节）、针对图像块特征的表示模型（第 5.2 节）、如何对视图进行掩码以计算 PMI（第 5.3 节），以及为提升性能而估计与潜在变量相关的 PMI 的方法（第 5.4 节）。

sents.en: Here, we describe how we instantiate RePR for learning representations from images.
sents.zh: 在此，我们描述了如何为从图像中学习表示而实例化 RePR。

paragraphs.en: The “Prediction Model” is implemented as a MAR ( Li et al., 2024b ) , a modification of Masked Autoencoders ( He et al., 2022 ) that replaces the patch regression head with a patch diffusion MLP. Specifically, MAR consists of an MAE Encoder E θ E_{\theta} (without mask tokens), MAE Decoder D θ D_{\theta} (with mask tokens) and a diffusion MLP M θ M_{\theta} . The diffusion MLP takes in the decoder latent corresponding to patch p , z p p,z_{p} , a noised view of p p , p t p_{t} , and trains to denoise p p , where we follow JiT ( Li and He, 2026 ) and use x x -prediction with a v-loss, depicted in Figure 1 .
paragraphs.zh: “预测模型”的实现基于 MAR（Li et al., 2024b），它是掩码自编码器（He et al., 2022）的一种改进版本，将块回归头替换为块扩散 MLP。 具体而言，MAR 由 MAE 编码器 E θ E_{\theta}（不含掩码标记）、MAE 解码器 D θ D_{\theta}（含掩码标记）和一个扩散 MLP M θ M_{\theta} 组成。 扩散 MLP 的输入包括对应于块 p 的解码器潜在表示 z p z_{p}、p 的加噪声版本 p t p_{t}，其训练目标是去除 p 的噪声；在此过程中，我们遵循 JiT（Li and He, 2026）的方法，使用 x 预测并结合 v-loss，具体如圖 1 所示。

paragraphs.en: MAR is convenient for estimating PMI because when estimating likelihoods for a contextualized latent, the cost of the Encoder and Decoder is shared, after which we can run the lightweight diffusion loss head many times to average across different noise levels.
paragraphs.zh: MAR 便于估计 PMI，因为在估计上下文相关的潜在变量的似然时，编码器和解码器的成本会被共享，之后我们可以多次运行轻量级的扩散损失头，以对不同噪声水平进行平均。

paragraphs.en: We distinguish between features that are directly supervised for structure, such as the CLS token of Contrastive Learners, DINO, or LeJEPA, and unregularized intermediate latents, such as the non-CLS tokens of DINO or the latents in an unregularized autoencoder. Without explicit structural supervision, these unregularized latents can diverge or collapse. For example, DINOv2 demonstrated outlier patch features, motivating the introduction of register tokens ( Darcet et al., 2024 ) , and in DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) , feature quality again degraded, necessitating an additional distillation stage to align model features with an earlier checkpoint, taken before degradation occurred. While heuristic regularization and interventions can correct divergence, these issues may become increasingly difficult to control with greater scale. Such feature instability motivates directly supervising patch features for principled and scalable tokenization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将直接用于结构监督的特征（例如 Contrastive Learners、DINO 或 LeJEPA 中的 CLS 标记）与未经正则化的中间潜在变量（例如 DINO 中的非 CLS 标记或未正则化自编码器中的潜在变量）区分开来。 在没有明确的结构监督下，这些未经正则化的潜在变量可能会发散或坍缩。 例如，DINOv2 出现了异常图像块特征，这促使研究者引入了注册标记（Darcet et al., 2024）；而在 DINOv3（Siméoni et al., 2025）中，特征质量再次下降，因此需要增加一个蒸馏阶段，将模型特征与退化发生前更早的检查点进行对齐。 尽管启发式正则化和干预措施可以纠正发散问题，但随着模型规模的扩大，这些问题可能变得越来越难以控制。 这种特征不稳定性促使我们直接对图像块特征进行监督，以实现更具理论依据且可扩展的标记化方法。

paragraphs.en: We find that recursively applying our training technique, by replacing the predicted incremental patches with features from a previous cycle of training, can yield additional gains. This mirrors findings in representation learning, where self-supervision by predicting in a feature space ( Hsu et al., 2021 ; Zhou et al., 2022 ; Baevski et al., 2022 ) has been shown to strongly improve representation quality over direct pixel prediction objectives such as MAE ( He et al., 2022 ) . Because a factorization of the PMI can reconstruct the input at optimality (App. A.4 ), unweighted PMI estimation for latent prediction is the same as for pixel prediction: PMI ⁡ ( 𝐱 , R θ ​ ( 𝐲 ) ) = PMI ⁡ ( 𝐱 , 𝐲 ) \operatorname{PMI}({\mathbf{x}},R_{\theta}({\mathbf{y}}))=\operatorname{PMI}({\mathbf{x}},{\mathbf{y}}) . With timestep weighting and bootstrapped prediction, feature-space prediction provides further control over learning signal. In practice, we embed the entire image R θ old ​ ( 𝐱 ) R_{\theta_{\text{old}}}({\mathbf{x}}) and substitute incremental patch p p for the patch representation corresponding to the same location in the image. By sharing feature calculation between A Repeat A_{\text{Repeat}} views, embedding with R θ old R_{\theta_{\text{old}}} is implementationally cheap.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发现，通过递归应用我们的训练技术——即将预测出的增量补丁替换为先前一轮训练中的特征——可以获得额外的性能提升。这与表征学习领域的研究结果一致：在特征空间中进行自监督预测（Hsu et al., 2021; Zhou et al., 2022; Baevski et al., 2022）已被证明能够显著提升表征质量，优于 MAE 等直接的像素级预测目标（He et al., 2022）。由于 PMI 的分解可以在最优条件下重构输入（附录 A.4），因此对于潜在变量预测而言，无加权 PMI 估计与像素预测的估计是相同的：PMI⁡(𝐱, Rθ​(𝐲))=PMI⁡(𝐱,𝐲) \operatorname{PMI}({\mathbf{x}},R_{\theta}({\mathbf{y}}))=\operatorname{PMI}({\mathbf{x}},{\mathbf{y}})。结合时间步加权与自举预测，特征空间预测能够进一步对学习信号进行控制。在实际应用中，我们嵌入整张图像 Rθold​(𝐱) R_{\theta_{\text{old}}}({\mathbf{x}})，并用增量补丁 p p 替换图像中相同位置所对应的补丁表征。通过在 A Repeat A_{\text{Repeat}} 视图中共享特征计算，使用 Rθold R_{\theta_{\text{old}}} 进行嵌入在实现上成本较低。

sents.en: In this section, we demonstrate that RePR is robust to Feature Suppression (Sec. 6.1 ), provide scaling laws for RePR as a Tokenizer Encoder (Sec. 6.2 ), and use RePR to obtain compute-optimal pixel diffusion (Sec. 6.3 ).
sents.zh: 在本节中，我们证明了 RePR 对特征抑制具有鲁棒性（第 6.1 节），为 RePR 作为标记器编码器提供了扩展定律（第 6.2 节），并利用 RePR 获得了计算上最优的像素扩散模型（第 6.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Existing representation learning methods such as contrastive learning suffer from an issue called Feature Suppression ( Geirhos et al., 2020 ; Chen et al., 2021a ; Li et al., 2023 ) where a self-supervised objective might learn only a minimal subset of features necessary to solve the downstream task (e.g. instance discrimination), while dropping the remaining latent variables. This can be disastrous when training tokenizers because the additional latent variables, while perhaps unnecessary for satisfying the contrastive objective, may be essential for reconstructing the data.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的表示学习方法（如对比学习）存在一个被称为“特征抑制”（Feature Suppression）的问题（Geirhos 等人，2020；Chen 等人，2021a；Li 等人，2023），即自监督目标可能仅学习到解决下游任务（例如实例区分）所需的最小特征子集，而忽略其余的潜在变量。 在训练分词器时，这种情况可能带来灾难性后果，因为尽管这些额外的潜在变量对于满足对比学习目标可能并非必需，但它们对于数据重建却可能是至关重要的。

paragraphs.en: To show our method is robust to Feature Suppression, we benchmark on a version of Imagenet that adds a visual watermark to every image patch that uniquely identifies the image in the dataset ( Enigma, 2026 ) . On such a dataset, contrastive losses become trivialized: merely identifying the image patch watermark is enough to attain a perfect loss. In Fig. 2 , we train LeJEPA ( Balestriero and LeCun, 2025 ) , DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) , and our proposed RePR approach on both standard ImageNet and on the watermarked version. On watermarked data, LeJEPA and DINOv3 collapse to only representing the shared watermark. Meanwhile, despite sharing the same PMI factorization guarantees as contrastive learners, our proposed RePR is robust.
paragraphs.zh: 为了展示我们的方法对特征抑制具有鲁棒性，我们在一个改进版的 Imagenet 数据集上进行了基准测试。该数据集为每个图像块添加了一个视觉水印，以唯一标识数据集中的图像（Enigma, 2026）。 在这样的数据集上，对比损失会变得微不足道：仅通过识别图像块中的水印就足以获得完美的损失值。 在图 2 中，我们在标准 ImageNet 和水印版数据集上分别训练了 LeJEPA（Balestriero and LeCun, 2025）、DINOv3（Siméoni et al., 2025）以及我们提出的 RePR 方法。 在水印数据上，LeJEPA 和 DINOv3 最终仅能表示共享的水印信息。 与此同时，尽管我们的 RePR 方法与对比学习模型具有相同的 PMI 分解保证，但它仍然表现出良好的鲁棒性。

paragraphs.en: In the previous section, we demonstrated that our method resists feature suppression on toy data, where prior representations collapse. In this section, we demonstrate encoder scaling laws: our model captures enough data for generation and predictably improves with scale on real data.
paragraphs.zh: 在上一节中，我们证明了我们的方法能够抵抗玩具数据中的特征抑制问题，而在此类数据上，先前的表示方法会失效。 在本节中，我们将展示编码器的扩展定律：我们的模型能够捕捉到生成所需的足够数据，并且随着规模扩大，在真实数据上的表现会呈现出可预测的改善。

sents.en: In the previous section, we demonstrated that our method resists feature suppression on toy data, where prior representations collapse.
sents.zh: 在上一节中，我们证明了我们的方法能够抵抗玩具数据中的特征抑制问题，而在此类数据上，先前的表示方法会失效。

sents.en: In this section, we demonstrate encoder scaling laws: our model captures enough data for generation and predictably improves with scale on real data.
sents.zh: 在本节中，我们将展示编码器的扩展定律：我们的模型能够捕捉到生成所需的足够数据，并且随着规模扩大，在真实数据上的表现会呈现出可预测的改善。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate encoder scaling laws using Latent Forcing ( Baade et al., 2026 ) , which first denoises in latent space and then generates pixels conditioned on the denoised latent. This lets us leverage the improved diffusability of learned representations while retaining generation directly in pixel space. The resulting generative process is lossless, avoiding the reconstruction–generation tradeoff of lossy latent tokenizers ( Yao et al., 2025b ) and isolating gains from diffusability rather than compression. Latent Forcing additionally enables controlled FLOP- and parameter-matched comparisons with direct pixel diffusion models such as JiT.
paragraphs.zh: 我们利用潜在强制法（Baade et al., 2026）展示了编码器的扩展定律：该方法首先在潜在空间中去除噪声，然后基于去噪后的潜在变量生成像素。 这使得我们能够在保留直接在像素空间进行生成的能力的同时，利用已学习表示所具备的增强扩散性。 由此产生的生成过程是无损的，避免了有损潜在标记化方法（Yao et al., 2025b）中重建与生成之间的权衡，并使得性能提升完全源于扩散性而非压缩。 潜在强制法还进一步支持了与 JiT 等直接像素扩散模型在浮点运算次数和参数规模上受控的对比研究。

paragraphs.en: We train RePR encoders from scratch across a range of compute scales. Following μ \mu P ( Yang et al., 2022 ) , we perform width-only scaling, sweeping widths from 256 to 1024 while holding depth fixed. At maximum width, the inference architecture matches a standard ViT-L. Full architectural and training details are provided in Appendix A.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们从零开始，在不同计算规模下训练 RePR 编码器。 遵循 μ \mu P (Yang et al., 2022) 的方法，我们仅对宽度进行缩放，将宽度从 256 逐步调整到 1024，同时保持深度不变。 在最大宽度下，推理架构与标准的 ViT-L 一致。 完整的架构和训练细节见附录 A.3。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 3 shows consistent power-law scaling across roughly two orders of magnitude of training compute on both ImageNet and GPIC. On ImageNet, we evaluate diffusability by training a JiT-Base diffusion transformer for 80 epochs; on GPIC, we use the MiniT2i architecture ( Wang et al., 2026 ) and train for one epoch. At each width, we additionally use feature prediction (Sec. 5.4 ) to predict features from a pixel model of the same size trained for 200 epochs, yielding a substantial improvement over the first iteration. Extrapolating the observed trend by at most 1 × 1\times beyond our measured log-scale FLOP range predicts DINOv2-level performance at approximately one-seventh the training FLOPs and WebSSL-level performance at roughly one-eighth. On ImageNet, the width-1024 model begins to overfit after 200 epochs, consistent with prior scaling-law observations ( Kim et al., 2026 ) ; scaling continues beyond this regime on GPIC.

paragraphs.en: To the best of our knowledge, we provide the first demonstration that representation learning combined with generative modeling can be more FLOP-efficient than direct generative modeling, even after accounting for the compute required to train both the representation and generative model. We isolate the comparison by using Latent Forcing ( Baade et al., 2026 ) , without perceptual losses ( Johnson et al., 2016 ) , GANs ( Goodfellow et al., 2021 ) , or external decoders. In Fig. 4 , we compare FID-10K on ImageNet between JiT-Large and Latent Forcing with two RePR tokenizer sizes for conditional and unconditional generation at equal FLOPs. At a compute budget of 1.19 × 10 20 1.19\times 10^{20} FLOPs, equal to 200 epochs of JiT-L training, RePR with JiT-L improves unguided FID-10K by 2.61 for conditional generation and 4.18 for unconditional generation versus JiT-L on pixels. In Tab. 4 , we demonstrate that our approach outperforms raw pixel diffusion with guidance, attaining an FID-50k of 2.18. Together with the encoder scaling laws established above, these results identify representation learning as an additional scaling axis that can improve generative performance more efficiently than scaling the generative model alone.
paragraphs.zh: 据我们所知，我们首次展示了将表示学习与生成建模相结合的方法，在考虑了训练表示模型和生成模型所需的计算量之后，仍然比直接进行生成建模更具 FLOP 效率。 我们通过使用潜在强制法（Baade et al., 2026），且不引入感知损失（Johnson et al., 2016）、GAN（Goodfellow et al., 2021）或外部解码器，实现了这一对比的隔离。 在图 4 中，我们在相同 FLOP 条件下，比较了 JiT-Large 和潜在强制法在 ImageNet 上的 FID-10K 指标，并分别测试了两种 RePR 分词器尺寸在条件生成和无条件生成中的表现。 在计算预算为 1.19 × 10^20 FLOPs（相当于 JiT-L 训练 200 个周期）时，与基于像素的 JiT-L 相比，结合 JiT-L 的 RePR 方法在条件生成中使未引导的 FID-10K 提升了 2.61，在无条件生成中提升了 4.18。 表 4 表明，我们的方法优于带有引导的原始像素扩散模型，实现了 2.18 的 FID-50k 值。 结合上述已确立的编码器扩展定律，这些结果表明，表示学习是一条额外的扩展维度，能够比单独扩展生成模型更高效地提升生成性能。

paragraphs.en: We introduce RePR, a theoretically motivated representation learning method for generative model tokenizers. RePR shares the theoretical guarantees of contrastive learning without requiring negative samples, while remaining robust to feature suppression in settings where prior representation learning methods collapse. We establish empirical scaling laws for diffusability and show that RePR-based generative models outperform direct diffusion on raw data at matched training FLOPs. Together, these results show that representation learning with strong theoretical foundations can coexist with and improve the scaling of generative modeling.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 RePR，这是一种基于理论动机的生成模型分词器表示学习方法。 RePR 共享了对比学习的理论保证，且无需负样本；同时，在先前表示学习方法失效的场景中，它仍能对特征抑制保持鲁棒性。 我们为可扩散性建立了经验缩放定律，并表明在训练 FLOPs 匹配的情况下，基于 RePR 的生成模型在原始数据上的表现优于直接扩散方法。 综合来看，这些结果表明，具有坚实理论基础的表示学习可以与生成建模的扩展共存，并促进其改进。

paragraphs.en: To implement E θ E_{\theta} without providing absolute position information, we use RoPE position embeddings. For encoder register tokens, we assign RoPE position to the center of the unmasked tokens. When using center-relative offset queries (Sec. 5.2 ), R θ R_{\theta} can output representations for unobserved patches, including patches outside of the image. Like convolutional networks, which are also spatially-equivariant, we find it empirically useful to pad one row and column of representation queries outside of the image. We find that R θ R_{\theta} emergently expresses low, but nonzero magnitude on these padding tokens. We explore adding a separate representation loss to the CLS tokens of R θ R_{\theta} , which we find have better probing performance than pooled spatial features, similar to ( Caron et al., 2021 ) . We adapt all transformer architecture decisions from JiT Li and He (2026) .
paragraphs.zh: 为了在不提供绝对位置信息的情况下实现 E θ E_{\theta}，我们使用了 RoPE 位置嵌入。 对于编码器寄存器令牌，我们将 RoPE 位置分配给未掩码令牌的中心。 当使用中心相对偏移查询（第 5.2 节）时，R θ R_{\theta} 可以为未观察到的图像块输出表示，包括图像外的图像块。 与同样是空间等变性的卷积网络类似，我们在经验上发现，在图像外部为表示查询填充一行和一列是有益的。 我们发现，R θ R_{\theta} 在这些填充令牌上会自发地表现出较低但非零的幅度。 我们尝试为 R θ R_{\theta} 的 CLS 令牌添加一个独立的表示损失项，我们发现其探测性能优于池化空间特征，这与 (Caron et al., 2021) 的研究类似。 我们所有的 Transformer 架构决策均改编自 JiT Li 和 He (2026) 的工作。

paragraphs.en: Because PMI ∗ \text{PMI}^{*} is asymmetric, and moreover, because PMI is not positive semi-definite, we indicate to R θ R_{\theta} which inputs correspond to incremental information 𝐳 {\mathbf{z}} (Eq. 15 ) distinctly from 𝐱 {\mathbf{x}} and 𝐲 {\mathbf{y}} . paragraphs.en: For all experiments, we report epochs as the total number of image views processed divided by the number of data samples in ImageNet. paragraphs.en: Reconstruction from PMI: With weak assumptions, PMI factorization can reconstruct the input. Let 𝐱 {\mathbf{x}} be an uncorrupted view of an image and 𝐲 {\mathbf{y}} be a pixel we wish to reconstruct. We assume nonzero support on all possible pixel values 𝐲 {\mathbf{y}} , which can be achieved by adding noise ϵ ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , δ ​ I ) {\bm{\epsilon}}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,\delta I) during training to pixels 𝐲 {\mathbf{y}} where δ > 0 \delta>0 may be arbitrarily small. Then, it is possible to reconstruct the data from the factorization of the PMI by iterating over all possible pixels z z and taking the maximum PMI with respect to 𝐱 {\mathbf{x}} : 𝐲 = arg ⁡ max 𝐳 ∼ All Pixels ​ ⟨ R ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) , R ⁡ ( 𝐳 ) ⟩ {\mathbf{y}}=\arg\max_{{\mathbf{z}}\sim\text{All Pixels}}\langle R({\mathbf{x}}),R({\mathbf{z}})\rangle . Although the PMI factorization may reconstruct the input with arbitrary quality in theory, in practice reconstruction quality will be affected by the masking functions sampled during training and the convergence of the network. Empirically, RePR-B Iter 3. obtains a PSNR of 21.72 (Table 5 ), 3.63 dB higher than DINOv2 when using the RAE ViT-XL decoder ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) .
